subject: Steering committee: FinIntegrate pilot - exec sponsor & security prep
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FinIntegrate discovery recap + ask for steering committee

Team - quick recap from this morning's discovery with FinIntegrate (Sarah Lopez, Head of Data; Tom Nguyen, CTO). I captured the notes in the attached PDF. Key takeaways and asks they surfaced: 

- Opportunity: 6-8 week pilot to validate inference latency and cost reductions on customer-facing insights pipeline. High potential for expansion into realtime scoring if pilot meets latency SLOs.
- Economic buyer: likely Mark Rivera (CFO) - Sarah will try to loop him in as exec sponsor, but Tom indicated the steering committee will need CFO buy-in on cost model.
- Security/compliance: they require SOC 2 Type II report, data flow diagram, and answers to a short questionnaire from their InfoSec team. Procurement will also run a standard vendor risk assessment.
- Timeline: procurement + legal + security cycle estimated 4-6 weeks once we provide artifacts; they want a steering committee meeting next week (two attendees from their side: Sarah and Tom; they may invite Mark if available).

Asks for this thread:
1) Rachel - can you pull our latest SOC2 and pen test summaries and package the security pack (redwood-security-pack.zip) to send?
2) Dev - please prepare a short 2-slide cost/latency summary for the pilot (expected token volumes, target latency SLOs, and proposed dedicated capacity).
3) Vivek - can you propose two 60-min windows next week for a steering committee meeting with an agenda? See my suggested agenda below.

Suggested steering committee agenda (30-60 min):
- Introductions & goals (5)
- Pilot scope & success criteria (10)
- Security & data handling overview (10)
- Commercial model & pilot pricing (10)
- Next steps / timelines / decision checkpoints (10)

I've attached the discovery notes and a draft agenda. I'll own coordination with Sarah/Tom but want us aligned on artifacts and who speaks to security vs cost.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: FinIntegrate-discovery-notes.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinIntegrate discovery recap + ask for steering committee

Thanks Marissa - copied the security artifacts I have. I'll assemble the minimal pack for procurement (SOC2 Type II summary, pen test executive summary, DPA template, and a short answers doc for their questionnaire). Draft attached: steering-committee-agenda-draft.docx.

A couple of notes for the call:
- We should have someone from Product Security on the call to answer detailed questions (I can bring in Priya or schedule a follow-up deep-dive).
- For procurement, they typically want an SP list and data retention policy upfront - I'll include both in the pack.
- Legal redlines: we can pre-share our standard DPA and a handful of commonly requested redline positions to expedite.

I'll target sending the security pack to Sarah and procurement@finintegrate.com by EOD tomorrow.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
rachael.kim@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-security-pack.zip, steering-committee-agenda-draft.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinIntegrate discovery recap + ask for steering committee

All - available windows next week (PST):
- Tue 8 Dec: 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Thu 10 Dec: 09:00-10:00 or 15:00-16:00

I'll own the pilot sizing slide. For the agenda, can we keep the pilot success criteria explicit (latency < 200ms p95, cost < $X per 1M tokens, and integration timeline <= 3 weeks)? If those are acceptable I'll include them on slide 2.

Also - procurement will probably ask about data residency and whether any customer PII will be sent to hosted environments; best to be explicit about options (Hosted API with tokenization, Dedicated pools, Private deployment).

- Vivek

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@finintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finintegrate.com>, procurement@fintegrate.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Steering committee: FinIntegrate pilot - exec sponsor & security prep

Thanks Marissa - this is great. We reviewed the agenda draft and the timeline looks right. Mark Rivera (our CFO) is out Friday but said he'd try to join if we schedule the meeting Tue 8 Dec 14:00-15:00 PST. Can you confirm that slot? If not, Tom and I can do Tue 10:00-11:00.

On security: procurement asked for the SOC2 summary and the DPA sample - please send both to procurement@finintegrate.com. We also have a short internal checklist (attached) that our InfoSec team will run - it's mostly clarifications and a couple of network/IP allowlist items.

Next steps as I see them:
- Redwood to send security pack + DPA sample to procurement by EOD tomorrow
- Redwood to confirm steering committee slot (prefer Tue 8 Dec 14:00-15:00 if Mark can make it)
- Redwood to prepare 2 slides: (1) pilot scope & success criteria, (2) cost/latency overview

Looking forward - Sarah
